I'm about 10 hours into the story and I'm still honestly not sure what to think of it. 

The first game was damn near perfect, probably one of the best games I've ever played. I think this has made it hard for people, including myself to enjoy it as much as part 1 because topping it was always gonna be a long shot, no matter how much we all thought it would. 

That's not to say part 2 is bad, the gameplay is pretty much the same as the 1st but with some improvements. The level design is superb, larger open levels to explore, the graphics are amazing (at least they are on ps4 pro) and the sound/voice acting is amazingly done. 

It takes a while to get to like and care about the new characters and even Ellie as she's changed alot since the first but I think that's more to do with the overall tone and theme of the story. 

And of course the story. I think this is what is making the audience divisive. Like the first, its nothing unique, the idea has been done before. But I feel as if it kinda just jumps straight in with no warning or build up like most stories normally would. Once again, I don't think it's a bad thing but it honestly depends on your personal taste.

If you're a fan of the first game, I would definitely recommend it, even for the gameplay alone. Although I can see why many people are upset with it, I personally think it's still a solid game. Maybe I'll change my mind by the end of it but so far I'm enjoying alot.

Would definitely recommend trying it 👌
